data.name: GF6B_001
data.value: The trail ends here.[pause=15] This plateau wasn't on the map.

data.name: GF6B_002
data.value: Look at the grass.[pause=10] Scorched,[pause=10] in one straight line.

data.name: GF6B_003
data.value: (Something came through here.[pause=15] Fast.[pause=10] Very fast.)

data.name: GF6B_004
data.value: Hey.[pause=20] Hold it right there,[pause=10] you two.

data.name: GF6B_005
data.value: Who said that?[pause=20] There's nobody here...

data.name: GF6B_006
data.value: Three days I've heard you climbing.[pause=20] You're slow.

data.name: GF6B_007
data.value: We're looking for a lost Caterpie![pause=15] Have you seen him or not?

data.name: GF6B_008
data.value: (He's been watching us the whole time.[pause=15] And we felt nothing.)

data.name: GF6B_009
data.value: The little one is fine.[pause=15] Asleep,[pause=10] higher up,[pause=10] safe.

data.name: GF6B_010
data.value: But nobody crosses this plateau without racing me.[pause=20] One rule:[pause=10] first one down loses!

data.name: GF6B_011
data.value: The air is changing.[pause=15] Smells like a storm,[pause=10] and there isn't a cloud.

data.name: GF6B_012
data.value: HE OUTRAN THE STORM THAT MADE HIM.

data.name: GF6B_013
data.value: EVER SINCE,[pause=10] HE HAS SOUGHT A RACE WORTHY OF HIM.

data.name: GF6B_R01
data.value: The tangle of roots has loosened.[pause=20] Daylight is getting through, right down to the ground.

data.name: GF6B_R02
data.value: (He let us walk in.[pause=15] Or he simply isn't watching anymore.)

data.name: GF6B_R03
data.value: The forest breathes better since he stopped standing guard over it.

data.name: GF6B_R04
data.value: Nothing more to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.
